rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; equivalent. i8995 p. 3, Line 3 (the prior year's Form 8995 line 16 carryforward). Both give line 3 when qbi.prior_form is true and zero otherwise; the reply orders the two guards the other way ("ne true" for a Bool answer is "eq false"). executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/qbi.json, executable-triage-v2): 2,672 of 2,672 agree. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The difference is that of qbi.taxable_before (line 11b and the Schedule A choice plus line 13b against line 11a less line 12e), equal in value within the slice; the Stage 14 selection between Form 8995 and Form 8995-A agrees on both sides.

Ruling: representation; f8995 p. 1: "Use this form if your taxable income, before your qualified business income deduction, is at or below $197,300 ($394,600 if married filing jointly)"; i8995 p. 1, a patron of a specified cooperative uses Form 8995-A. Both choose Form 8995 line 15 at or under the threshold and Form 8995-A above it. The reply routes a cooperative patron to Form 8995-A and refuses suspended losses (qbi.suspended) and a REIT/PTP carryforward (qbi.reit_loss) by reading those answers directly; the project refuses all three through qbi.unsupported (amb.2025.qbi_cooperative_patron), asking qbi.suspended only with a Schedule C and qbi.reit_loss only with a 2024 Form 8995. executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/qbi.json, executable-triage-v2): 1,992 of 2,672 agree; 476 candidate-unknown (34 completed, e.g. classm.f2441.1.deepseek: qbi.suspended not asked, project $0) and 204 project-refuses on refused returns; no value difference. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The deduction before the QBI deduction now adds Form 1040 line 13b, the zero parameter behind the Schedule 1-A refusal (BUG-0007), to the Schedule A choice; the second transcription, told that Schedule 1-A is refused, omitted the term. Equal in value in this slice; the term is kept so the line 13b refusal propagates and the expression reads as the corrected instruction ("Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b", i8995-correction). No change to the data.

Ruling: representation; f1099div p. 5: "Box 5. Shows the portion of the amount in box 1a that may be eligible for the 20% qualified business income deduction under section 199A". The project copies qbi.dividends_if_ordinary, asked only when ordinary dividends (box 1a) are above zero, and carries the qbi.unsupported refusal (REIT/PTP carryforward, suspended losses, cooperative patron; amb.2025.qbi_cooperative_patron); the reply copies qbi.dividends directly and leaves those cases to other screens. executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/qbi.json, executable-triage-v2): 2,372 of 2,672 agree; 151 candidate-unknown (13 completed: box 5 not asked, project $0), 125 project-unknown and 24 project-refuses on incomplete or refused returns; no value difference. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f8995 p. 1, line 12, "Enter your net capital gain, if any, increased by any qualified dividends", and i8995 p. 4, Line 12, "line 3a, plus your net capital gain": the candidate omits the qualified dividends (Form 1040 line 3a), which the project adds through f1040.line3a_if_ordinary. Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.

Ruling: representation; project retained. As ruled before: the project reads Form 1040 line 11b (line 11a for a filer without the Schedule 1-A deduction, which is refused) and subtracts the Schedule A choice plus line 13b, the zero behind the Schedule 1-A refusal, as the corrected instruction reads (i8995-correction); the second subtracts lines 12e and 13b from line 11a directly, equal in value within the slice. Stage 14 did not change this line.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The project reads Form 1040 line 11b (line 11a for a filer without the Schedule 1-A deduction, which is refused) and subtracts the Schedule A choice plus line 13b, the zero behind the Schedule 1-A refusal, as the corrected instruction reads (i8995-correction); the second subtracts lines 12e and 13b from line 11a directly, equal in value within the slice. Both floor at zero where the instruction states no floor; the deduction is unchanged because Form 8995 line 13 floors at zero itself. No change to the data.
